subject: Re: Draft MAP: SDK & streaming integration — owners & timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Chen <mike@cannyhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:12:30 -0500
Subject: Draft MAP: SDK + Streaming integration plan

Hi Mike — great chat earlier today. Thanks for walking through your ingestion flow and the requirements for real-time clinical summarization. Per our call, I drafted a short Mutual Action Plan focused on the integration milestone (SDK + streaming + tool-calling + structured outputs).

Summary / ask
- Target close (contract): 2027-02-28 (we flagged this as your preferred end-of-quarter). Please confirm if that still works.
- Integration milestone (owner & ETA): SDK integration + streaming prototype ready for initial validation by 2027-02-10. Can you confirm your engineering owner for integration (we heard it might be your platform lead)?
- Responsibilities (high-level):
  - Redwood: provide SDK, sample streaming client, telemetry hooks, and a runbook for KV caching and token budgeting.
  - Canny Health: provide sanitized sample payloads, network allowlists, and a point-of-contact for SOC/compliance evidence if needed.
- Dependencies: procurement for reserved capacity (if you want Dedicated), access to a staging cluster for 2 weeks, and a finalized data-handling appendix.
- Next actions: please review the attached MAP draft (redwood-map-sdk-streaming-v0.1.pdf) and the SDK checklist (sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx), confirm the engineering owner and one preferred date for the kickoff readout.

Attachments: redwood-map-sdk-streaming-v0.1.pdf (MAP draft), sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx (owner checklist)

Thanks — I can be flexible with kickoff times next week.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Onward: draft MAP attached for your review.

From: Mike Chen <mike@cannyhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@cannyhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 16:02:10 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: SDK + Streaming integration plan

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes: 
- Confirmed: target close 2027-02-28 still looks good but can we leave a week buffer (so 2027-03-07 as fallback) — budgeting cycle ends first week of March.
- Engineering owner: Sanjay Rao (platform lead) is on copy; he’ll be our point for the integration. We’ll also loop in R&D engineer Priya for the streaming client.
- Dependencies: we can get sanitized payloads by 01/18 and aim to have a staging cluster window 02/01–02/14. Procurement cycle might push Dedicated beyond close but we can start on hosted + pin model versions.

I reviewed the MAP draft — looks reasonable. I’ll confirm Sanjay’s availability for a kickoff on 01/20 or 01/21 (EST).

Mike
Mike Chen
Head of Product, Canny Health
mike@cannyhealth.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP: SDK + Streaming integration plan — owner confirmation needed

Hi team — forwarding Mike’s reply. Finance/procurement aside, they committed to a staging window and a likely owner (Sanjay). Can we do the following?

Proposed internal owner assignments (please confirm or reassign):
- Integration lead (SDK + streaming prototype): Rohan Mehta (eng). Owner should drive the SDK drop, sample client, and telemetry hooks.
- Platform liaison (network, allowlists, infra): Karthik Iyer (you)
- Security/compliance evidence and SOC 2 coordination: Laura Bennett
- Customer success kickoff / acceptance criteria: Marissa Cole

Requested timelines (internal):
- SDK alpha to Canny: 2027-01-24
- Streaming prototype (end-to-end) for staging: 2027-02-03
- Integration validation window with Canny: 2027-02-07 to 2027-02-14

Notes/risks:
- If procurement delays Dedicated capacity past 02/14, we should ensure hosted flow meets latency SLOs at pilot scale. Karthik — can you validate whether hosted config at their expected QPS will be acceptable?
- Need sanitized payloads by 01/18 (Mike confirmed). If they miss that date, alpha may slip by ~1–2 weeks.

Please reply-all with confirmed owners and any changes to the dates. I’ll update the MAP and push a V0.2 to the Drive link.

-Jasmine
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jan 10, 2027 at 4:02 PM Mike Chen <mike@cannyhealth.com> wrote:...

Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP: SDK + Streaming integration plan — owner confirmation needed

Thanks Jasmine — I’m happy to own platform liaison and I’ve assigned Rohan Mehta as the primary integration lead.

Updated (internal) owner commitments and revised ETA: 
- Rohan Mehta (Integration lead): SDK alpha to Canny by 2027-01-26 (slight move to allow for a 2-day code review cycle). Will deliver sample streaming client and a smoke-test harness.
- Karthik Iyer (Platform liaison): validate hosted capacity and configure KV caching defaults for the expected sequence lengths by 2027-01-22. I’ll confirm the QPS numbers we used for the smoke tests.
- Laura Bennett (Security): start evidence collection and request list for SOC/compliance by 2027-01-18.
- Marissa Cole (CS): draft acceptance criteria and success metrics by 2027-01-20.

I’ll update the MAP (v0.2) with these owner lines and share the Drive link; Jasmine, please push the v0.2 PDF to the HubSpot deal record once it’s ready.

Karthik
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
